title: Tell us what you saw
intro: A sentence or a picture is enough. It shows us where The Olive Lot helps in the grove — and where it gets in the way.
commentPlaceholder: Something that wasn’t clear, something missing, or something that went well.
submitHint: A note or one picture is enough.
needSomething: Write a few words or add a picture.
sendFailed: It didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.
thanksBody: We’ll keep it. People who say what they see in the grove are why The Olive Lot gets more useful.
